# util_cue (Data Source)

Evaluates a [CUE](https://cuelang.org/) file or package and exposes the result as a dynamic Terraform value.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String) Path to a CUE file or directory to evaluate. When a directory is specified, all `.cue` files in that directory sharing the same package clause are loaded as a package. Relative paths are resolved from the Terraform working directory.

### Optional

- `input` (List of String) Additional CUE expressions to unify with the loaded file. Useful for applying inline constraints or merging additional configuration.
- `package` (String) Package name to select when loading a directory that contains multiple packages. Ignored for single-file loading.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags to inject into the CUE evaluation (equivalent to `cue eval -t key=value`). Values are strings; use `@tag(name, type=int)` in CUE for typed injection.

### Read-Only

- `result` (Dynamic) The evaluated CUE value as a native Terraform type.
